"""Typed payload models for the compiled fuzz frames."""
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Union

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator, model_validator

from modules.byte_program import Context


class H3HeaderFrame(BaseModel):
    Type: str = Field('headers', description="Fixed value, 'headers'")
    headers_kv: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = Field(
        None,
        description='Header mapping form; normalized into data_to_transfered')
    data_to_transfered: Optional[List[Any]] = Field(
        None,
        description='Compiled [name, value] byte-sequence pairs')
    End_Stream: bool = Field(False, description='End the stream after this frame')

    @model_validator(mode='after')
    def process_headers(self):
        if self.headers_kv is not None:
            if not self.data_to_transfered:
                self.data_to_transfered = [[key, value]
                                           for key, value in self.headers_kv.items()]
            self.headers_kv = None
        elif self.data_to_transfered is None:
            self.data_to_transfered = []
        return self


class H3DataFrame(BaseModel):
    Type: str = Field('data', description="usually 'data'")
    data_to_transfered: Any = Field(
        ..., description='Compiled byte sequence content of the payload')
    End_Stream: bool = Field(True, description='End the stream after this frame')


class H3SleepFrame(BaseModel):
    Type: str = Field('sleep', description="always 'sleep'")
    Time_to_Stop: int = Field(..., description='Pause duration in milliseconds')


class FuzzingPayload(BaseModel):
    test_cases: Dict[str, List[Union[H3HeaderFrame, H3DataFrame, H3SleepFrame]]] = Field(
        ...,
        description='Ordered collection of test cases keyed by case name')


def compile_cases(cases, context: Context):
    """Build the typed payload model from validated input case dictionaries."""
    classes = {'headers': H3HeaderFrame, 'data': H3DataFrame,
               'datagram': H3DataFrame, 'sleep': H3SleepFrame}
    data = {}
    for case in cases:
        frames = []
        for compiled in case['_frames']:
            frames.append(classes[compiled['Type']](**compiled))
        data[case['name']] = frames
    return FuzzingPayload.model_construct(test_cases=data)
